title: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation becomes applicable
what_happens: PFAS limits on food-contact packaging take effect with no transition period for non-compliant stock; conformity, minimisation and EPR requirements apply to any packaging placed on the EU market.
why_watch: Applies regardless of origin, so any EU-bound product or packaging component must comply from this date.

title: New York Governor's decision on the GRAS ingredient-disclosure bill
what_happens: Signature or veto due on S.1239F/A.1556G. Legal/trade-press coverage confirms the bill has not yet been formally presented to the Governor; once presented she has 10 days (excluding Sundays) to act, but under NY procedure the Legislature can hold delivery until year-end, giving a statutory backstop of Dec. 31, 2026. No presentment date has been reported yet, so the decision could come at any point between now and then. IDFA has written urging a veto.
why_watch: Would be the first state law mandating disclosure of self-affirmed GRAS safety data, and a likely template for other states.

title: Senate floor action on the Childhood Diabetes Reduction Act of 2026
what_happens: Bill advanced out of the Senate HELP Committee 12-10 and awaits a full Senate vote; would require front-of-pack warning labels on high sugar, saturated fat and sodium products.
why_watch: Thresholds would directly implicate whole milk, butter, full-fat cheese and sweetened dairy; the pre-floor-vote window is when positioning matters.

title: Senate Agriculture Committee markup of Farm Bill 2.0 (Agricultural Act of 2026)
what_happens: Full committee markup and vote on whether to advance the farm bill to the full Senate; the dairy title includes mandatory manufacturer cost/yield reporting to update FMMO make-allowance factors, plus reauthorization of the Dairy Indemnity Payment Program and Dairy Promotion and Research Board through 2031.
why_watch: First concrete legislative test of a new mandatory dairy-manufacturer reporting requirement tied to Federal Milk Marketing Order pricing; amendments offered during markup could expand or narrow the compliance scope.

title: US tariffs on Canadian imports including dairy take effect
what_happens: 50% Section 338 tariffs (signed by proclamation July 20, 2026) come into force on Canadian-origin whey products, milk protein concentrates, lactose, casein/caseinates and milk powders; cheese, butter, yogurt, fluid milk/cream, sour cream and ice cream are exempted.
why_watch: Direct cost and supply-chain implications for cross-border dairy ingredient trade; IDFA and NMPF have both issued public statements.

title: FDA's mandatory GRAS-notification proposed rule — anticipated Federal Register publication
what_happens: Proposed rule (RIN 0910-AJ02) ending reliance on purely self-affirmed GRAS status for most substances completed OMB/OIRA review July 31, 2026; the 2026 Unified Regulatory Agenda lists anticipated Federal Register publication, which opens the public comment period, for December 2026.
why_watch: Publication starts the comment clock on the biggest change to the GRAS pathway in decades, affecting nearly every food and dairy ingredient supplier that relies on self-affirmed GRAS determinations.

title: FDA ultra-processed food definition — outcome of OIRA review
what_happens: FDA/HHS sent a 'Proposed Definition of Ultra-Processed Food' whitepaper to OIRA on August 3, 2026, filed as a notice (not a rule; no legal deadline). HHS Secretary Kennedy has said it could become the basis for a front-of-pack red-yellow-green labeling system, but no rule, guidance, or timeline has been announced.
why_watch: Would be the definitional foundation for any future UPF-based labeling or program restriction, running in parallel with the Sanders and Booker/Blumenthal Senate warning-label bills.
